max_single_reservation.source: rs-env-probe vm (windows): largest power-of-two MEM_RESERVE|PAGE_NOACCESS reservation granted. This is a bound on RESERVATION, not on commit - on Windows those are separate operations and it is the commit that charges the pagefile, so a request within this bound can still fail at commit time (RS-VM-0012 is the finding for that model difference)
